question: Should ClawRouter support a non-Cloudflare production runtime, and what minimum parity must it guarantee for identity, authoritative policy and budget state, queues, retention, assets, migrations, and operations?
rationale: The request expands supported platform scope across several safety-critical and stateful services, and current repository policy does not establish whether full or reduced non-Cloudflare operation belongs on the roadmap.

options.title: Sponsor portable runtime parity
options.body: Approve provider-neutral service contracts and require the Docker implementation to pass functional, safety, migration, and upgrade parity checks.

options.title: Keep Cloudflare production-only
options.body: Continue supporting Wrangler local development while retaining Cloudflare as the sole production runtime.

options.title: Define reduced local edition
options.body: Approve a clearly delimited self-hosted mode with explicit unsupported capabilities and safeguards against mistaking it for full production parity.

recommendation.title: Sponsor portable runtime parity
recommendation.body: Approve provider-neutral service contracts and require the Docker implementation to pass functional, safety, migration, and upgrade parity checks.
